items.title: Why IBM, Microsoft Back Move for Quantum Policy Czar
items.summary: A new bill aims to secure U.S. supply chains and elevate the Commerce Department to lead national quantum policy.

items.title: Should You Worry That IBM Has Gone Quiet On Its AI Total?
items.summary: International Business Machines (IBM) used to hand investors a single number that made its AI push easy to check: the running dollar value of the generative-AI work it had won. That number is missing from the July 2026 call, though generative AI still turns up in the Consulting numbers. Where the figure went, and what management counts instead, is the more useful question.

items.title: IonQ (IONQ) Down 1.8% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Rebound?
items.summary: IonQ (IONQ) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.title: Silicon Motion Surges 186% in Past Year: Reason to Buy the Stock?
items.summary: SIMO's 186.1% surge reflects strength in NAND controllers, expanding customer ties, product innovation and growth across AI, cloud and autos.

items.title: 2 Services Stocks to Research Further and 1 Facing Challenges
items.summary: Business services providers thrive by solving complex operational challenges for their clients, allowing them to focus on their secret sauce. Furthermore, the demand for their offerings is rising as more clients outsource non-core functions, a trend that has enabled the industry to return 19.8% over the past six months. At the same time, the S&P 500 was up 11.7%.

items.title: The Business Accenture Now Mentions In Passing
items.summary: Accenture (ACN) is redirecting where its next growth comes from, and the business underneath is in decent shape. What deserves a second look is what got left behind. Two years ago management was presenting a learning arm it had built itself. On the June 2026 call it survived as one item in a list.
